title: Aquatic rotation for a year on OCEAN2. Only the water layer managed: every in-embark water entry allowed and assigned by the matrix, groups, coupling and ecology off, rotation enabled. 404,000 ticks (a year), two replicates. Every 5,000 ticks the wild feature-layer units on the map are counted by species. Questions: does an assigned water species ever arrive outside its seasons; when a species goes out of season, do its fish leave the map or die in place, and how long after the boundary.
fork: v5.8 water rotation: is the land rotation's zero-out-of-season result true of the water layer, and what happens to the animals already on the map at a boundary.

predictions.expects: zero out-of-season water arrivals; out-of-season fish linger (E26: 150k+) and leave on their own countdown, none die of the boundary

predictions.model: the feature ledger fights the roster
predictions.expects: an out-of-season water arrival, or in-season entries not refilled after the boundary

kill_criterion: zero out-of-season water arrivals in 2 of 2 clears v5.8's water rotation; the fate of the animals at a boundary sets the water layer's release rule
culling: drop the replicate on any breach or changed save

arms.name: water
pre: local sw=reqscript('seasonal-wildlife'); local cfg=sw.loadConfig(); if not cfg.initialized then sw.captureDefault(cfg) end; cfg.layers.land=false; cfg.layers.water=true; cfg.layers.cavern=false; local pool=sw.buildPool(cfg); local n,w=0,0; for _,e in ipairs(pool) do if e.inEmbark and sw.defaultAllow(e) then cfg.allow[e.key]=true; n=n+1; if e.layer=='water' then w=w+1 end end end; local a,f=sw.assignFromMatrix(cfg,pool); cfg.groups.enabled=false; cfg.groups.coupling=false; cfg.ecology.enabled=false; sw.saveConfig(cfg); local act=sw.applyLive(cfg, df.global.cur_season); sw.saveConfig(cfg); sw.enableSched(); local parts={}; for k,v in pairs(cfg.assign) do if k:sub(1,6)=='water:' then parts[#parts+1]=k..'='..table.concat(v,'') end end; table.sort(parts); print(('roster: water layer only — %d allowed (%d water), %d assigned, %d thin, %d applied; groups off; rotation enabled | %s'):format(n,w,a,f,act,table.concat(parts,' ')))

do: local n,fe={},0; for _,u in ipairs(df.global.world.units.active) do if dfhack.units.isWildlife(u) and not dfhack.units.isDead(u) and u.animal.population.feature_idx>=0 then fe=fe+1; local t=df.creature_raw.find(u.race).creature_id; n[t]=(n[t] or 0)+1 end end; local parts={}; for t,c in pairs(n) do parts[#parts+1]=t..'x'..c end; table.sort(parts); print(('e20 water units: %d [%s] season %d day %d'):format(fe, table.concat(parts,' '), df.global.cur_season, math.floor(df.global.cur_year_tick/1200)))
